eventDetail.scope: ICCSIS 2026 provides a distinguished international platform for advancing research in computational intelligence and autonomous system technologies. The conference scope encompasses theoretical foundations and practical methodologies spanning machine learning, intelligent control, distributed computing, and cyber-physical system integration. We welcome contributions addressing novel algorithms, system architectures, optimization strategies, and their deployment across industrial automation, robotics, smart infrastructure, and data-intensive applications. The program emphasizes interdisciplinary approaches that bridge computer science innovations with intelligent system engineering, fostering collaboration among researchers and practitioners working toward robust, scalable, and secure intelligent technologies for real-world challenges.
